config.section:
You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed only to keep the request shape stable. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.

config.prefix: You are a helpful software engineer assistant.

config.description:
Run commands in a bash shell
* When invoking this tool, the contents of the "command" parameter does NOT need to be XML-escaped.
* Network access depends on the task environment. Prefer configured mirrors/proxies when they are available.
* State is persistent across command calls and discussions with the user.
* To inspect a particular line range of a file, e.g. lines 10-25, try 'sed -n 10,25p /path/to/the/file'.
* Please avoid commands that may produce a very large amount of output.
* Please run long lived commands in the background, e.g. 'sleep 10 &' or start a server in the background.

Run commands in a PowerShell shell
* When invoking this tool, the contents of the "command" parameter does NOT need to be XML-escaped.
* You don't have access to the internet via this tool.
* State is persistent across command calls and discussions with the user.
* Use native Windows paths (C:\...) and $env:NAME variables; this is PowerShell, not bash.
* Please avoid commands that may produce a very large amount of output.
* Please run long lived commands in the background, e.g. 'Start-Job' or start a server with Start-Process.

plugin-manager.description: The pnpm executable, registries, and limits for diagnostics, lookups and connection checks.

fields.name: pnpmCommand
fields.description: The pnpm executable name or path; resolved through `PATH` like the `dsh plugin` command.

fields.name: outputBytes
fields.description: Maximum retained package-operation diagnostic bytes.

fields.name: lockWaitMs
fields.description: Maximum time to wait for another process's profile package operation.

fields.name: inspectTimeoutMs
fields.description: Bound on one registry lookup an inspection runs, in milliseconds.

fields.name: githubConnectionTimeoutMs
fields.description: Maximum duration of the GitHub repository connection check before installation, in milliseconds.

fields.name: idleTimeoutMs
fields.description: Maximum time one captured package run may print nothing before the manager terminates it, in milliseconds.

fields.name: registry
fields.description: The registry lookups and installations ask first, as an http(s) URL; absent, the one pnpm's own configuration names.

fields.name: fallbackRegistries
fields.description: Registries asked in turn, as http(s) URLs, while the one before is unreachable or holds no copy of the package. A registry outside this set and `registry` is asked alone, and so is the one pnpm's own configuration names unless that is npm's own registry or one of these.

hmr.description: Module roots and watcher timing, with Chokidar deployment options.

fields.name: base
fields.description: Directory resolved against the owning context's base URL.

fields.name: root
fields.description: Module watch roots; an empty list leaves only explicit configuration watches.

fields.name: ignored
fields.description: Glob patterns excluded from module watching.

fields.name: debounce
fields.description: Milliseconds for combining module changes.

llm.description: Provider-neutral LLM service interface for the DeepSeek Harness

deepseek-llm-api-extensions.description: Additive request-field registry for the official DeepSeek LLM API adapter

session.description: Event-sourced session store for the DeepSeek Harness

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Contribute `dsh_session_log` to official DeepSeek requests. Defaults to `true`.

fields.name: maxBytes
fields.description: Largest serialized `dsh_session_log` field, in UTF-8 bytes, that one request carries. A request uploads the longest pending event prefix that fits; later requests continue after its acceptance. Defaults to 8 MiB.

typert.description: Runtime registry for generated package reflection and Zod schemas

typert-loader.description: Additional package artifacts whose owning plugins are nested behind another Loader entry.

fields.name: packages
fields.description: Exact npm package names that must resolve and export `./typert`.

fields.name: websocketHeartbeatIntervalMs
fields.description: WebSocket Ping interval from 1 through 2,147,483,647 milliseconds.

fields.name: streamInboxBytes
fields.description: Buffered uplink frame bytes one logical stream may hold before it fails with `gateway/uplink-overflow`.

remote-access.description: Method-level Remote access control for non-owner Peers and the per-Peer access snapshot

session-title.description: Required deterministic fallback and accepted-title limits.

fields.name: fallbackMaxWords
fields.description: Maximum whitespace-delimited words in the built-in fallback.

fields.name: fallbackMaxBytes
fields.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes in the built-in fallback.

fields.name: maxTitleBytes
fields.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes in any accepted title.

session-title-llm.description: Required execution controls plus this provider's title-length targets; no defaults.

fields.name: targetWords
fields.description: Target word count for non-CJK titles.

fields.name: targetCjkCharacters
fields.description: Target character count for Chinese, Japanese, or Korean titles.

fields.name: maxInputBytes
fields.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes in the provider-prepared user input.

fields.name: maxOutputTokens
fields.description: Output-token cap for the title request, independent of conversation requests.

fields.name: timeoutMs
fields.description: End-to-end auxiliary request deadline in milliseconds.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Optional explicit provider route; must be paired with `model`.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Optional explicit model id; must be paired with `provider`.

user-questions.description: Abstract user-questions seam (ctx.userQuestions) for asking the human during agent runs

agent.description: Agent interface, registry, initiator scope, and event vocabulary for the DeepSeek Harness

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Contribute `dsh_plugin_packages` to official DeepSeek requests. Defaults to `true`.

agent-default-model.description: Default model selection supplied by plugin configuration.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Registered provider route.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Provider-owned model id.

fields.name: reasoningEffort
fields.description: Adapter-owned reasoning effort; omission follows the provider default.

jobs.description: Configuration for the process-local job registry.

fields.name: maxConcurrentJobsPerOwner
fields.description: Maximum `running` plus `stopping` jobs per exact owner or in the shared unowned bucket; omission defaults to 10.

fields.name: retainBytes
fields.description: Live ring retention per job in UTF-8 bytes; omission defaults to 262144.

fields.name: settledRetainBytes
fields.description: Ring retention kept after a job settles, in UTF-8 bytes; omission defaults to 16384. Settlement keeps every byte the model cursor has not consumed on top of this cap; the first terminal model read then trims to it.

fields.name: pumpPollMs
fields.description: Poll interval for a job's pull sources, in milliseconds; omission defaults to 150.

llm-retry.description: This policy executor has no config; providers own `retryPolicy`.

config-editor.description: Persist plugin configuration through profile patches and Loader reconciliation

settings.description: Abstract user-settings seam (ctx.settings) for the DeepSeek Harness

authorization.description: Authorization seam (ctx.authorization): plugin-owned flows that obtain a credential through a conversation with the human

fields.name: platformOrigin
fields.description: Platform origin serving auth-api and browser pages.

fields.name: desktopPlatform
fields.description: Native desktop identity for Host API and embedded Platform requests; null identifies the client as web.

fields.name: embeddedPageDist
fields.description: Optional frontend deployment selector for embedded Usage and Top-up pages.

fields.name: inferenceOrigin
fields.description: Exact HTTP(S) origin allowed to receive account tokens for inference and files.

fields.name: allowLoopbackHttp
fields.description: Allow HTTP only on loopback for the development Mock.

fields.name: rewriteBrowserOrigin
fields.description: Map authorization and completion pages to platformOrigin for private development proxies.

fields.name: requestHeaders
fields.description: Host-only headers sent exclusively to platformOrigin; account authorization cannot be overridden.

fields.name: accountRequestHeaders
fields.description: Overrides for profile, balance and embedded Platform requests; Cookie pairs merge by name. Logout retains requestHeaders.

fields.name: requestTimeoutMs
fields.description: Deadline for each platform HTTP request.

fields.name: balanceTimeoutMs
fields.description: Deadline for recharge-wallet queries; timeout returns a failed balance outcome.

fields.name: logoutMaxRetries
fields.description: Additional logout attempts after the first request fails, at most five.

fields.name: logoutRetryDelayMs
fields.description: Delay before the first logout retry; each later delay doubles.

fields.name: attemptTimeoutMs
fields.description: Upper bound for the entire local attempt, even if the server advertises a longer TTL.

credentials.description: Plugin config: file location and hot-reload behavior.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Credentials document path; defaults to `.credentials.yaml` under the harness home.

fields.name: dshHome
fields.description: Harness home used when `path` is omitted; defaults to `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`.

fields.name: watch
fields.description: Watch the document and hot-publish external edits; defaults to true.

fields.name: debounceMs
fields.description: Watcher write-settle window in milliseconds; defaults to 100.

llm-pi-ai.description: Plugin configuration: the provider routes this instance owns.

fields.name: providers
fields.description: pi-ai provider routes, keyed by provider. An empty (or omitted) dict is the dormant settings-driven posture: the adapter mounts with no routes and registers them the moment a settings section supplies profiles.

session-persistence-jsonl.description: Plugin config for the JSONL backend's root, physical encoding, and listing concurrency.

fields.name: root
fields.description: Root directory for all session files. Required (no default): a default of `process.cwd()` would scatter session files as the process's cwd changes (bash calls, subprocesses). Sessions group under human-readable project directories, then per-session directories. An existing root must be a readable directory; an absent root is created on first materialization.

fields.name: compression
fields.description: Physical encoding; defaults to checksummed Zstandard frames.

fields.name: listConcurrency
fields.description: Maximum directory, header, and stat reads in flight across all concurrent listings of this backend (`list()`, the root encoding check, and historical fingerprints). Defaults to 3.

fields.name: dshHome
fields.description: Explicit harness home; omitted follows `DSH_HOME`, then `~/.dsh`.

fields.name: maxImageBytes
fields.description: Maximum encoded bytes accepted for one submitted image. Default: 20 MiB.

fields.name: maxImagesPerMessage
fields.description: Maximum image count accepted in one submitted message. Default: 20.

fields.name: maxMessageImageBytes
fields.description: Maximum aggregate encoded image bytes accepted in one submitted message. Default: 200 MiB.

fields.name: maxImagePixels
fields.description: Maximum intrinsic width multiplied by height accepted for one submitted image. Default: 64,000,000.

fields.name: maxImageDimension
fields.description: Maximum intrinsic width and maximum intrinsic height accepted for one submitted image. Default: 8192px.

fields.name: normalizedImageMaxPixels
fields.description: Total-pixel budget of the stored provider-independent normalized image.

fields.name: normalizedImageMaxDimension
fields.description: Long-edge pixel cap of the stored provider-independent normalized image, applied after the total-pixel budget.

fields.name: normalizedImageMaxBytes
fields.description: Encoded-byte target of the stored provider-independent normalized image; the smallest quality-ladder output is kept when no quality fits.

fields.name: imageCompressionConcurrency
fields.description: Maximum simultaneous normalization or request-image transformations in this service instance.

session-query-sqlite.description: Combined session-query configuration backed by SQLite full-text search.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Dedicated derived-index path; `:memory:` is supported for ephemeral indexes. Missing directories and database files are created owner-only on POSIX filesystems; existing modes are preserved.

fields.name: openAt
fields.description: Open the SQLite module and handle at service activation or the first search, or `never` to disable full-text search: the inherited exact reads, filters, and traces stay available, while `searchSessions` and `searchEvents` fail with `SESSION_QUERY_SEARCH_DISABLED` and SQLite is never imported or opened. Defaults to `startup`.

fields.name: journalMode
fields.description: SQLite journal mode. Defaults to `wal`.

fields.name: defaultLimit
fields.description: Page size when a request omits `limit`. At most `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 1`; defaults to 20.

fields.name: maxLimit
fields.description: Largest accepted page size. At most `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 1`; defaults to 100.

fields.name: snippetChars
fields.description: Maximum snippet length in Unicode code points. Defaults to 240.

fields.name: readWindowMax
fields.description: Maximum accepted raw read context on either side. Defaults to 50.

fields.name: persistedReadConcurrency
fields.description: Maximum concurrent persisted-log reads in one inherited batch read. Defaults to 4.

fields.name: preparedSessionCacheSize
fields.description: Maximum cold prepared-Session observations the inherited reader retains for reuse. Defaults to 5.

working-directory.description: Deployment default for Sessions without an original project directory.

fields.name: defaultDirectory
fields.description: Absolute execution-world fallback directory; omitted values use the launch directory.

tool-working-directory.description: Read and change the active Session working directory

session-projection.description: Session-projection seam: the merge-extensible projection type table, the provider contract, and the ctx.sessionProjections registry serving whole current values of log-derived per-session state

storage.description: Storage hub (ctx.storage): named backend registry plus mounted data-form facilities for the DeepSeek Harness

storage-json.description: Plugin configuration. `root` has NO default on purpose: a `process.cwd()` fallback would scatter unit files wherever the process happens to start; assemblies state the location explicitly.

fields.name: root
fields.description: Directory holding one `<unit>.json` file (or `<unit>/` tree) per unit.

storage-domain.description: Plugin config. Which backend serves which domain is decided here, not globally on the hub: `backend` is the default route and `routes` overrides it per domain name. A route naming an unregistered backend fails loud at `open` with `backend-not-found`.

fields.name: backend
fields.description: Default backend name for every domain without an explicit route. Required: there is no universally correct medium.

fields.name: routes
fields.description: Per-domain overrides: domain name → backend name.

session-projection-cache.description: Plugin config. Both throttle triggers are deployment choices with no universally correct value, so the composition states them explicitly (cordis.yml); the three mandatory write points (session creation, `turn/end`, and session disposal) are policy, not tunables, and always fire.

fields.name: writeEveryEvents
fields.description: Committed events per session that force a durable checkpoint write between mandatory points.

fields.name: writeIntervalMs
fields.description: Longest time (milliseconds) a dirty checkpoint may stay unwritten between mandatory points.

otel.description: Cordis service for independent ordinary-event and byte-bounded Session-log OTLP channels

session-telemetry-otel.description: Plugin configuration: sharing policy, SDK transport options, byte/count queue settings, and an overall shutdown bound. Uploading modes validate their endpoint and shutdown deadline at plugin load; `DISABLED` reads neither.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Defaults to `FEEDBACK_ONLY`: capture session history only when feedback is explicitly submitted.

fields.name: exporter
fields.description: Explicit SDK HTTP transport settings, including optional routing headers. Ambient credentials are not inherited. URL is required while uploading. Exporter self-observability metering is not supported.

fields.name: processor
fields.description: Count, queue, cadence, and per-request watchdog settings for the byte-bounded processor. A watchdog warning never releases an unsettled transport slot. SDK processor self-observability metering is not supported.

fields.name: shutdownTimeoutMillis
fields.description: Maximum time spent awaiting the SDK provider's complete shutdown path.

fields.name: maxRequestBytes
fields.description: Uncompressed OTLP request byte limit, at most 4,000,000.

subprocess.description: Local-subprocess implementation of the DeepSeek Harness subprocess seam

sandbox.description: Plugin config. All optional — `static Config` supplies the defaults.

fields.name: runnerCommand
fields.description: Override the runner argv; bwrap-compatible profile arguments are appended. A non-empty override asserts full enforcement and skips built-in selection and probing. A runner that starts but refuses its profile must be identifiable by . Consumers classify a spawn rejection only after confirming the workdir is usable. `ENOENT` or `EACCES` identifies the runner when `error.path` equals argv[0] and `error.syscall` is `spawn` or `spawn <runner>`, or when `error.path` is absent and `error.syscall` is exactly `spawn <runner>`.

fields.name: runnerFailureSignatures
fields.description: Case-insensitive stderr substrings emitted when a configured refuses its profile before executing the wrapped command. Required and non-empty with `runnerCommand`; rejected without it. Each entry is a non-empty, single-line, case-insensitive substring covering the executable runner's own failure dialect.

fields.name: probeTimeoutMs
fields.description: Positive timeout for each functional probe; zero would mean unbounded to Node.

sandbox-policy.description: Plugin config: the deployment's sandbox default. All optional — `Config` supplies the defaults (`mode: 'read-only'` is the fail-safe default; a deployment that wants a workspace-writable agent opts in explicitly). The runner choice is NOT here (it is the `ctx.sandbox` provider's config), nor is any per-family knob: this is the one shared policy home.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: File-sandbox mode a session starts from (default: `read-only`).

fields.name: workspaceRoot
fields.description: Absolute fallback root for agentless calls and sessions without a cwd (default: `process.cwd()`). Normal agent calls use their session cwd instead.

bash-sandbox.description: Plugin config: the local executor's knobs, verbatim. The sandbox policy — the default mode and fallback `workspace-write` root — is NOT here: it lives on `ctx.sandboxPolicy` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-policy`), which resolves each calling session's mode and cwd for every enforcing capability. The runner choice is likewise the `ctx.sandbox` provider's config, not this executor's.

fields.name: cwd
fields.description: Default working directory for commands (default: process.cwd()).

fields.name: timeoutMs
fields.description: Default foreground timeout in milliseconds.

fields.name: maxTimeoutMs
fields.description: Upper bound for per-call timeout overrides.

fields.name: maxOutputBytes
fields.description: Per-stream in-memory output cap; overflow spills to a temp file.

fields.name: maxSpillBytes
fields.description: Per-stream spill-file cap; larger streams retain only their in-memory tail.

fields.name: graceMs
fields.description: Grace period for kill escalation and inherited pipes; at most `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`.

pwsh-sandbox.description: Plugin config: the local executor's knobs, verbatim. The sandbox policy — the default mode and fallback `workspace-write` root — is NOT here: it lives on `ctx.sandboxPolicy` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-policy`), which resolves each calling session's mode and cwd for every enforcing capability. The runner choice is likewise the `ctx.sandbox` provider's config, not this executor's.

fields.name: cwd
fields.description: Default working directory for commands (default: process.cwd()).

fields.name: timeoutMs
fields.description: Default foreground timeout in milliseconds.

fields.name: maxTimeoutMs
fields.description: Upper bound for per-call timeout overrides.

fields.name: maxOutputBytes
fields.description: Per-stream in-memory output cap; overflow spills to a temp file.

fields.name: maxSpillBytes
fields.description: Per-stream spill-file cap; larger streams retain only their in-memory tail.

fields.name: graceMs
fields.description: Grace period for kill escalation and inherited pipes; at most `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`.

fields.name: pwshPath
fields.description: Explicit pwsh executable. When omitted, well-known Windows install locations and PATH entries are probed in order (PowerShell 7 install, PATH entries such as the Microsoft Store install, then Windows PowerShell 5.1), falling back to a bare `pwsh` resolved through PATH.

approval.description: Plugin config. All optional — `static Config` supplies the defaults.

fields.name: policy
fields.description: The deployment's default for sessions without an `approval/policy` override — `'ask'` delegates to the composed answerers (fail-closed with none); `'never'` auto-rejects every ask without prompting (the deterministic CI/unattended stance).

permission.description: The config: preset table and composition default.

fields.name: presets

workspace-write.name: workspace-write
workspace-write.description: Write inside the workspace and permitted temporary directories; wider retries require approval.

danger-full-access.name: danger-full-access
danger-full-access.description: Full file access without approval prompts.

fields.description: The preset table: name → knob bundle. Defaults to `workspace-write` (workspace-write + ask) and `danger-full-access` (danger-full-access + never). The names `custom` and `auto` are reserved for derived state and the Auto review integration respectively.

fields.name: defaultPreset
fields.description: Default for new sessions. When omitted, the preset matching the composed sandbox and approval defaults is used.

shell-env.description: Plugin config (all optional — the built-in facts resolve without defaults).

fields.name: dshHome
fields.description: DeepSeek Harness home directory exposed as `DSH_HOME`; defaults to `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`.

fs-observation-policy.description: File-context policy plugin for the DeepSeek Harness — observed-state, read-before-edit, and version-guarded write/edit added over the ctx.fs provider seam through the fs/* event gate (no service API)

fields.name: collectCacheMaxEntries
fields.description: Maximum number of completed cwd/provider catalogs kept in memory.

commands.description: Plugin-owned human command registry for DeepSeek Harness UIs

command-feedback.description: Log-only session feedback: the record event, the sessionFeedback Host Remote, and the human-facing slash command

fields.name: defaultMaxGoalRounds
fields.description: Total rounds used when a create request omits its own cap.

token-meter.description: Token-meter plugin configuration; the fixed estimator has no settings.

subagent.description: Host configuration for continuable subagent capacity.

fields.name: maxDepth
fields.description: Default delegation depth for tools without an explicit limit; defaults to 1.

fields.name: maxActiveSubagents
fields.description: Maximum live children sharing uninterrupted continuable parent links; defaults to 8.

fields.description: Age in days after which a spill file is eligible for the one-shot startup cleanup sweep. Defaults to `30`; `0` disables cleanup entirely. Files whose `mtime` is strictly older than the cutoff are deleted and emptied directories are pruned; fresh files, symlinks, and unrelated entries are left untouched. On POSIX, cleanup skips roots and session directories that another local user could modify or replace. Retention is deliberate — a resumed or forked session may still reference an older locator until it ages out.

fields.name: host
fields.description: Listen address: a concrete IPv4 or IPv6 literal of one local interface, for example the container's own Pod address from `hostname -i`. A loopback literal (any address in 127/8, `::1`, or a mapped form of either) keeps the server on this machine; any other literal serves the network that address belongs to, over plain HTTP unless `tls` is set. The unspecified address — IPv4 any, IPv6 any, and the IPv4-mapped forms of IPv4 any — is rejected at load: it would expose the port on every interface at once.

fields.name: tls
fields.description: Serve HTTPS with this certificate and key instead of plain HTTP. Both files are read once, before the listener binds: an unreadable or empty file, invalid PEM, or a key that does not match the certificate rejects initialization rather than falling back to HTTP. The material is never re-read, so replacing a certificate takes a reload. Omitted or null listens over plain HTTP.
